resources.description: Repair malformed JSON (trailing commas, single quotes, unquoted keys, code fences, truncated output) and optionally validate the result against a supplied JSON Schema. Returns the parsed value, the canonical text, a change log and validation errors.

Did it happen? Check whether a prediction market event has settled on Polymarket or Kalshi and get the resolved outcome, resolution time, source and market URL. A cheap oracle for agents that must verify a real-world outcome before acting.

What does the market think? Ask any event question in plain English and get the implied probability from live Polymarket and Kalshi prediction markets: per-venue odds, a liquidity-weighted consensus forecast, and a cross-venue divergence flag.

Scrape and fetch any public web page and return clean, LLM-ready Markdown plus metadata (title, author, published date, excerpt, outbound links, word count). A web reader and content extractor with boilerplate, nav and ads removed.
